quote: With the further improvement of substitution level, the FCR also significantly increased, and the low level of feed utilization limited the growth of Chinese perch.
statement: 随着替代水平的进一步提高，饲料系数（FCR）也显著增加，低水平的饲料利用率限制了鳜鱼的生长。
text_zh: 随着替代水平的进一步提高，饲料系数（FCR）也显著增加，低水平的饲料利用率限制了鳜鱼的生长。
text_en: As the replacement level further increased, the feed conversion ratio (FCR) also significantly increased, and the low level of feed utilization limited the growth of mandarin fish.

quote: Indeed, a high proportion of fish meal substitution would inhibit the growth of Chinese perch, as described previously [ 29 ], which might be caused by the antinutrients or imbalance of amino acid ratio in the feed.
statement: 高比例鱼粉替代会抑制鳜鱼生长，这可能由饲料中的抗营养因子或氨基酸比例失衡引起。
text_zh: 高比例鱼粉替代会抑制鳜鱼生长，这可能由饲料中的抗营养因子或氨基酸比例失衡引起。
text_en: High-proportion fish meal replacement inhibits the growth of mandarin fish, which may be caused by anti-nutritional factors or imbalanced amino acid ratios in the feed.

quote: It might be caused by the animal and plant protein sources used in this experiment can supplement each other with nutrients and other factors, causing a synergistic effect and promoting the digestion and absorption of protein.
statement: 这可能是由于实验中使用的动物和植物蛋白源在营养和其他因素上相互补充，产生协同效应，从而促进蛋白质的消化吸收。
text_zh: 这可能是由于实验中使用的动物和植物蛋白源在营养和其他因素上相互补充，产生协同效应，从而促进蛋白质的消化吸收。
text_en: This may be due to the animal and plant protein sources used in the experiment being complementary in terms of nutrition and other factors, producing a synergistic effect that promotes protein digestion and absorption.

quote: Similarly, replacing fish meal with a mixed animal and plant protein sources consisting of shrimp hydrolysate and plant protein mixture improved the growth performance of largemouth bass, and the use of compound protein reduced the fish meal content in their feed to 30% [ 16 ].
statement: 同样，用虾水解物和植物蛋白混合物组成的混合动植物蛋白源替代鱼粉改善了大口黑鲈的生长性能，且使用复合蛋白将饲料中鱼粉含量降低至30%。
text_zh: 同样，用虾水解物和植物蛋白混合物组成的混合动植物蛋白源替代鱼粉改善了大口黑鲈的生长性能，且使用复合蛋白将饲料中鱼粉含量降低至30%。
text_en: Similarly, replacing fishmeal with a mixed animal and plant protein source composed of shrimp hydrolysate and plant protein improved the growth performance of largemouth bass, and using the composite protein reduced the fishmeal content in the feed to 30%.

quote: In this study, the substitution of 27.27% and 54.55% fish meal with composite protein sources in diets significantly reduced the levels of TG and LDLC in the serum of Chinese perch, indicating that compound protein enhanced the body's absorption and utilization of lipids, improved the body's blood lipid levels and lipid metabolism function.
statement: 在本研究中，日粮中复合蛋白源替代27.27%和54.55%的鱼粉显著降低了鳜血清中的甘油三酯（TG）和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDLC）水平，表明复合蛋白增强了机体对脂质的吸收和利用，改善了血脂水平和脂质代谢功能。
text_zh: 在本研究中，日粮中复合蛋白源替代27.27%和54.55%的鱼粉显著降低了鳜血清中的甘油三酯（TG）和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDLC）水平，表明复合蛋白增强了机体对脂质的吸收和利用，改善了血脂水平和脂质代谢功能。
text_en: In this study, replacing 27.27% and 54.55% of fish meal with a composite protein source in the diet significantly reduced serum triglyceride (TG) and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDLC) levels in mandarin fish, indicating that the composite protein enhanced lipid absorption and utilization by the body, improving blood lipid levels and lipid metabolism function.

quote: The network structures were significantly altered between treatments due to dietary modification.
statement: 由于饮食修饰，处理间的网络结构发生了显著改变。
text_zh: 由于饮食修饰，处理间的网络结构发生了显著改变。
text_en: Due to dietary modification, the network structure changed significantly between treatments.

quote: Since carnivorous fish have a relatively high demand for dietary protein, excessive use of plant proteins with an amino acid imbalance (lacking lysine and methionine) as a substitute for fish meal can result in a series of negative effects, such as growth inhibition, decreased immune function, and deterioration of meat quality [ 30 , 31 ].
statement: 由于肉食性鱼类对膳食蛋白需求较高，过量使用缺乏赖氨酸和蛋氨酸的植物蛋白替代鱼粉会导致生长抑制、免疫功能下降和肉质恶化等负面影响。
text_zh: 由于肉食性鱼类对膳食蛋白需求较高，过量使用缺乏赖氨酸和蛋氨酸的植物蛋白替代鱼粉会导致生长抑制、免疫功能下降和肉质恶化等负面影响。
text_en: Because carnivorous fish have high dietary protein requirements, excessive use of plant proteins deficient in lysine and methionine to replace fishmeal leads to negative effects such as growth inhibition, decreased immune function, and deteriorated meat quality.

quote: In general, compared with the replacement of a single plant or animal protein source, mixed protein sources replace fish meal better, as the nutritional components complement each other, which can not only increase the proportion of alternative fish meal, but also be more conducive to improve the nutrient absorption and utilization, and health of farmed animals [ 16 , 32 ].
statement: 总体而言，与单一植物或动物蛋白源替代相比，混合蛋白源能更好地替代鱼粉，因为营养成分互补，这不仅提高了鱼粉替代比例，还有利于改善养殖动物的营养吸收利用和健康状况。
text_zh: 总体而言，与单一植物或动物蛋白源替代相比，混合蛋白源能更好地替代鱼粉，因为营养成分互补，这不仅提高了鱼粉替代比例，还有利于改善养殖动物的营养吸收利用和健康状况。
text_en: Overall, compared with replacement by a single plant or animal protein source, mixed protein sources can better replace fish meal because their nutritional components are complementary, which not only increases the proportion of fish meal replacement but also benefits the nutrient absorption and utilization and health status of farmed animals.

quote: Wang et al. [ 33 ] showed that compound animal and plant protein composed of fly maggot meal, peanut meal, corn gluten meal, soybean meal, and gluten meal successfully replaced fish meal, and under the same substitution ratio, had a higher WGR than the compound plant protein group.
statement: Wang等人研究表明，由蝇蛆粉、花生粕、玉米蛋白粉、豆粕和谷朊粉组成的动植物复合蛋白成功替代了鱼粉，且在相同替代比例下，其增重率高于复合植物蛋白组。
text_zh: Wang等人研究表明，由蝇蛆粉、花生粕、玉米蛋白粉、豆粕和谷朊粉组成的动植物复合蛋白成功替代了鱼粉，且在相同替代比例下，其增重率高于复合植物蛋白组。
text_en: Wang et al. showed that a combined animal and plant protein composed of maggot meal, peanut meal, corn gluten meal, soybean meal, and wheat gluten successfully replaced fish meal, and at the same replacement ratio, its weight gain rate was higher than that of the combined plant protein group.

quote: As expected, replacement of fish meal with the compound protein preparation directly led to changes in microbial communities and diversity.
statement: 用复合蛋白制剂替代鱼粉直接导致了肠道微生物群落和多样性的变化。
text_zh: 用复合蛋白制剂替代鱼粉直接导致了肠道微生物群落和多样性的变化。
text_en: Replacing fishmeal with a compound protein preparation directly led to changes in the intestinal microbial community and diversity.

quote: Significant differences in Simpson index (the lower the Simpson's index the higher the diversity) could be observed between the gut microbes of fish fed the fish meal-rich diet (D1 group) and the compound protein preparation diet (D2 and D3 groups).
statement: 喂食富含鱼粉饲料（D1组）与喂食复合蛋白制剂饲料（D2和D3组）的鱼之间，肠道微生物的Simpson指数存在显著差异。
text_zh: 喂食富含鱼粉饲料（D1组）与喂食复合蛋白制剂饲料（D2和D3组）的鱼之间，肠道微生物的Simpson指数存在显著差异。
text_en: There is a significant difference in the Simpson index of gut microbiota between fish fed a diet rich in fish meal (D1 group) and fish fed a diet with a compound protein preparation (D2 and D3 groups).

quote: The increase in diversity among the substituted groups can be attributed to higher level of plant-based and other animal protein ingredients, due to the possibility of increased stress from plant-based and other animal protein ingredients promoting metabolic diversity [ 53 ].
statement: 替代组肠道微生物多样性的增加可归因于植物源和其他动物蛋白成分水平较高，这可能是因为这些成分引起的应激促进了代谢多样性。
text_zh: 替代组肠道微生物多样性的增加可归因于植物源和其他动物蛋白成分水平较高，这可能是因为这些成分引起的应激促进了代谢多样性。
text_en: The increase in gut microbial diversity in the replacement group may be attributed to higher levels of plant-based and other animal protein ingredients, possibly because stress induced by these ingredients promoted metabolic diversity.
outcome: 肠道微生物多样性与应激

quote: may be due to the lower digestibility of protein and amino acids in a diet with high proportion of plant protein raw materials.
statement: 这种下降可能是由于高比例植物蛋白原料日粮中蛋白质和氨基酸的消化率较低所致。
text_zh: 这种下降可能是由于高比例植物蛋白原料日粮中蛋白质和氨基酸的消化率较低所致。
text_en: This decrease may be due to the lower digestibility of protein and amino acids in diets with a high proportion of plant protein ingredients.

quote: Based on the transcriptome data, fish in D2 group had relatively low influence compared with the D3 group.
statement: 基于转录组数据，D2组鱼类受到的影响相对较小，与D3组相比。
text_zh: 基于转录组数据，D2组鱼类受到的影响相对较小，与D3组相比。
text_en: Based on transcriptome data, the fish in group D2 were relatively less affected compared to group D3.
outcome: 基因表达调控影响程度

quote: Although excessive substitution of composite protein preparations (D3 group, 54.55%) also increased Cetobacterium abundance, the microbial interaction would be reduced and Cetobacterium might compete with other microbes, leading to lower fish quality.
statement: 尽管过量替代复合蛋白制剂（D3组，54.55%）也增加了Cetobacterium的丰度，但微生物相互作用会减少，且Cetobacterium可能与其他微生物竞争，导致鱼品质下降。
text_zh: 尽管过量替代复合蛋白制剂（D3组，54.55%）也增加了Cetobacterium的丰度，但微生物相互作用会减少，且Cetobacterium可能与其他微生物竞争，导致鱼品质下降。
text_en: Although the excessive replacement of the compound protein preparation (D3 group, 54.55%) also increased the abundance of Cetobacterium, microbial interactions decreased, and Cetobacterium may compete with other microorganisms, leading to a decline in fish quality.
intervention_record: 过量复合蛋白制剂替代
counterevidence: 过量替代导致品质降低

quote: These results indicate that a suitable composite mixture of chicken meal, krill meal, and plant proteins has no adverse effect on growth performance of Chinese perch and could improve muscle quality, lipid metabolism, and gut microbiota interactions.
statement: 这些结果表明，由鸡肉粉、磷虾粉和植物蛋白组成的合适混合物对鳜鱼的生长性能没有不利影响，并且可以改善肌肉质量、脂质代谢和肠道微生物群相互作用。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，由鸡肉粉、磷虾粉和植物蛋白组成的合适混合物对鳜鱼的生长性能没有不利影响，并且可以改善肌肉质量、脂质代谢和肠道微生物群相互作用。
text_en: These results indicate that a suitable mixture composed of chicken meal, krill meal, and plant protein had no adverse effect on the growth performance of mandarin fish, and could improve muscle quality, lipid metabolism, and gut microbiota interactions.

quote: 柱状嗜纤维菌可造成严重的鳃和皮肤病变, 直至引起鱼的死亡[ 1] 。
statement: 柱状嗜纤维菌感染会导致鱼类出现严重的鳃部和皮肤损伤，并可能致死。
text_zh: 柱状嗜纤维菌感染会导致鱼类出现严重的鳃部和皮肤损伤，并可能致死。
text_en: Fibrobacter columnaris infection causes severe gill and skin damage in fish, and may be lethal.

quote: Intracerebroventricular (ICV) injection of Npy promoted feeding in goldfish ( Carassius auratus ) and zebrafish ( Danio rerio )
statement: 脑室内注射神经肽Y（Npy）可促进金鱼和斑马鱼的摄食。
text_zh: 脑室内注射神经肽Y（Npy）可促进金鱼和斑马鱼的摄食。
text_en: Intracerebroventricular injection of neuropeptide Y (Npy) promotes feeding in goldfish and zebrafish.

quote: Due to the weak carbohydrate utilization by carnivorous species in fish, the high carbohydrate levels in the fish diet (mainly starch) might lead to persistent postprandial hyperglycemia [ 55 ].
statement: 由于肉食性鱼类对碳水化合物的利用能力较弱，饲料中高水平的碳水化合物（主要是淀粉）可能导致持续的餐后高血糖。
text_zh: 由于肉食性鱼类对碳水化合物的利用能力较弱，饲料中高水平的碳水化合物（主要是淀粉）可能导致持续的餐后高血糖。
text_en: Due to the weak ability of carnivorous fish to utilize carbohydrates, high levels of carbohydrates (mainly starch) in feed may lead to sustained postprandial hyperglycemia.

quote: Although the abundance of Cetobacterium improved with the compound protein preparation diet, nearly all the indicators of fish quality were better in D2 group than in the D3 fish.
statement: 尽管复合蛋白制剂饮食提高了Cetobacterium的丰度，但D2组的几乎所有鱼类质量指标都优于D3组。
text_zh: 尽管复合蛋白制剂饮食提高了Cetobacterium的丰度，但D2组的几乎所有鱼类质量指标都优于D3组。
text_en: Although the compound protein preparation diet increased the abundance of Cetobacterium, almost all fish quality indicators in group D2 were superior to those in group D3.

quote: Thus, fish could regulate the relative abundance of Cetobacterium to adapt to changes in diet, but excessive substitution with compound protein preparation might be harmful to fish quality.
statement: 因此，鱼类可以通过调节Cetobacterium的相对丰度来适应饮食变化，但过度使用复合蛋白制剂替代可能对鱼类质量有害。
text_zh: 因此，鱼类可以通过调节Cetobacterium的相对丰度来适应饮食变化，但过度使用复合蛋白制剂替代可能对鱼类质量有害。
text_en: Therefore, fish can adapt to dietary changes by regulating the relative abundance of Cetobacterium, but excessive use of compound protein preparations as substitutes may be harmful to fish quality.
intervention_record: 过量复合蛋白制剂替代

quote: Scientists discovered that L-glutamate rapidly promotes food consumption using a quantitative feeding assay
statement: 科学家通过定量摄食试验发现L-谷氨酸能迅速促进食物消耗。
text_zh: 科学家通过定量摄食试验发现L-谷氨酸能迅速促进食物消耗。
text_en: Scientists found through quantitative feeding trials that L-glutamate can rapidly promote food consumption.

quote: Studies have shown that fortifying meals with an appropriate amount of monosodium glutamate (MSG) may improve food intake
statement: 研究表明，在膳食中添加适量的味精（MSG）可能会改善食物摄入量。
text_zh: 研究表明，在膳食中添加适量的味精（MSG）可能会改善食物摄入量。
text_en: Studies show that adding an appropriate amount of monosodium glutamate (MSG) to the diet may improve food intake.

quote: 现已证实, 用脂多糖浸泡鱼苗, 可以获得一定程度的免疫保护力[ 10]
statement: 使用脂多糖浸泡鱼苗可获得一定程度的免疫保护力。
text_zh: 使用脂多糖浸泡鱼苗可获得一定程度的免疫保护力。
text_en: Soaking fish fry with lipopolysaccharide can provide a certain degree of immune protection.

quote: 脂多糖作为保护性抗原在用弧菌疫苗免疫鲑的实验中也得到证实[ 11]
statement: 在弧菌疫苗免疫鲑鱼的实验中，证实了脂多糖可作为保护性抗原。
text_zh: 在弧菌疫苗免疫鲑鱼的实验中，证实了脂多糖可作为保护性抗原。
text_en: In experiments on salmon immunized with Vibrio vaccine, it was confirmed that lipopolysaccharide can serve as a protective antigen.

quote: The adult mandarin fish brain was collected after treatment with MS-222 for primary culture (see below).
statement: 成年鳜鱼大脑在经MS-222处理后被采集用于原代培养。
text_zh: 成年鳜鱼大脑在经MS-222处理后被采集用于原代培养。
text_en: Adult mandarin fish brains were collected for primary culture after MS-222 treatment.
outcome: 实验操作中的动物处理

quote: In the liver, GPx activity and the content of MDA were significantly upregulated after 7 days of domestication, while in the gills, SOD activity was significantly upregulated after 7 days of domestication and GPx activity was significantly downregulated after 14 days of domestication.
statement: 在肝脏中，驯化7天后GPx活性和MDA含量显著上调；而在鳃中，驯化7天后SOD活性显著上调，驯化14天后GPx活性显著下调。
text_zh: 在肝脏中，驯化7天后GPx活性和MDA含量显著上调；而在鳃中，驯化7天后SOD活性显著上调，驯化14天后GPx活性显著下调。
text_en: In the liver, GPx activity and MDA content were significantly upregulated after 7 days of acclimation; in the gills, SOD activity was significantly upregulated after 7 days of acclimation, and GPx activity was significantly downregulated after 14 days of acclimation.

quote: These results suggest that artificial feed domestication is associated with oxidative stress.
statement: 这些结果表明人工饲料驯化与氧化应激有关。
text_zh: 这些结果表明人工饲料驯化与氧化应激有关。
text_en: These results indicate that artificial feed acclimation is associated with oxidative stress.

quote: In this study, we conducted experiments on the expression and enzyme activity changes of oxidative stress-related genes in the liver and gills of Mandarin fish after domestication with artificial feed
statement: 本研究对人工饲料驯化后鳜鱼肝脏和鳃中氧化应激相关基因的表达及酶活性变化进行了实验。
text_zh: 本研究对人工饲料驯化后鳜鱼肝脏和鳃中氧化应激相关基因的表达及酶活性变化进行了实验。
text_en: This study conducted experiments on the changes in expression of oxidative stress-related genes and enzyme activities in the liver and gills of mandarin fish after domestication to artificial feed.
outcome: 氧化应激指标（基因表达与酶活性）

quote: no significant difference was observed in the body length (BL) or body weight (BW) of the S. chuatsi . There was also basically no difference in growth between domesticated Siniperca chuatsi fed with artificial feed and those fed with live bait in the short term.
statement: 在短期（14天）内，人工饲料驯化对翘嘴鲌的体长、体重及生长性能没有显著影响。
text_zh: 在短期（14天）内，人工饲料驯化对翘嘴鲌的体长、体重及生长性能没有显著影响。
text_en: Over the short term (14 days), artificial feed acclimation had no significant effect on body length, body weight, and growth performance of Culter alburnus.

quote: Liang [ 7 ] and Wu [ 8 ] addressed the problem of active compound feeding of S. chuatsi by studying their feeding behavior and sensation mechanisms.
statement: Liang和Wu通过研究鳜鱼的摄食行为和感觉机制，解决了其主动配合饲料投喂的问题。
text_zh: Liang和Wu通过研究鳜鱼的摄食行为和感觉机制，解决了其主动配合饲料投喂的问题。
text_en: Liang and Wu solved the problem of active feeding with formulated feed for mandarin fish by studying its feeding behavior and sensory mechanisms.

quote: Studies have shown that, compared to live-baited S. chuatsi , the conversion rate of S. chuatsi fed with artificial feed is higher, the fullness and viscera-to-body ratio are significantly lower, and the meat quality and taste are better
statement: 研究表明，与投喂活饵的鳜鱼相比，投喂人工饲料的鳜鱼转化率更高，饱腹度和脏体比显著降低，肉质和口感更好。
text_zh: 研究表明，与投喂活饵的鳜鱼相比，投喂人工饲料的鳜鱼转化率更高，饱腹度和脏体比显著降低，肉质和口感更好。
text_en: Studies show that compared to mandarin fish fed live bait, mandarin fish fed artificial feed have a higher conversion rate, significantly reduced satiety and viscera index, and better flesh quality and texture.
counterevidence: 饱腹度降低可能暗示摄食不足或应激

quote: The gut microbiota’s α-diversity index in the S. chuatsi receiving artificial feed is significantly higher than that of live-baited S. chuatsi
statement: 接受人工饲料的鳜鱼肠道微生物群的α多样性指数显著高于投喂活饵的鳜鱼。
text_zh: 接受人工饲料的鳜鱼肠道微生物群的α多样性指数显著高于投喂活饵的鳜鱼。
text_en: The alpha diversity indices of the gut microbiota in mandarin fish fed artificial feed were significantly higher than those in mandarin fish fed live bait.

quote: The control group continued to receive live bait fish, while the experimental group was fed artificial feed and live fish in a 1:1 ratio for 7 days, followed by solely artificial feed for 7–14 days
statement: 实验组采用人工饲料与活鱼1:1混合投喂7天，随后仅投喂人工饲料7-14天，对照组继续投喂活饵鱼。
text_zh: 实验组采用人工饲料与活鱼1:1混合投喂7天，随后仅投喂人工饲料7-14天，对照组继续投喂活饵鱼。
text_en: The experimental group was fed a 1:1 mixture of artificial feed and live fish for 7 days, followed by feeding only artificial feed for 7-14 days; the control group continued to be fed live baitfish.
intervention: Replacing live bait with artificial feed

quote: Before sampling, both groups of fish were starved for 24 h
statement: 在采样前，两组鱼均禁食24小时。
text_zh: 在采样前，两组鱼均禁食24小时。
text_en: Before sampling, fish in both groups were fasted for 24 hours.

quote: During the sampling process, the selected fish were first anesthetized with MS-222 (Sigma Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA)
statement: 在采样过程中，选定的鱼首先使用MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在采样过程中，选定的鱼首先使用MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: During sampling, the selected fish were first anesthetized using MS-222.

quote: The expression of keap1 , kappa , gsta , SOD , and CAT was significantly downregulated after 14 days, and the expression of kappa was significantly downregulated after 7 days, while the expression of gstt1 and gstk1 was significantly upregulated after 7 days.
statement: 14天后，keap1、kappa、gsta、SOD和CAT的表达显著下调；7天后，kappa的表达显著下调，而gstt1和gstk1的表达显著上调。
text_zh: 14天后，keap1、kappa、gsta、SOD和CAT的表达显著下调；7天后，kappa的表达显著下调，而gstt1和gstk1的表达显著上调。
text_en: After 14 days, the expression of keap1, kappa, gsta, SOD and CAT was significantly downregulated; after 7 days, the expression of kappa was significantly downregulated, while the expression of gstt1 and gstk1 was significantly upregulated.

quote: In this study, we mainly investigated the impact of feed domestication on the expression of oxidative stress-related genes in S. chuatsi , thereby affecting their survival rate.
statement: 本研究主要调查了饲料驯化对鳜鱼氧化应激相关基因表达的影响，进而影响其存活率。
text_zh: 本研究主要调查了饲料驯化对鳜鱼氧化应激相关基因表达的影响，进而影响其存活率。
text_en: This study mainly investigated the effect of feed domestication on the expression of oxidative stress-related genes in mandarin fish, which in turn affects their survival rate.

quote: With the development of large-scale and intensive aquaculture, excessive aquaculture density and poor water quality and environment have led to an increase in stress factors in the environment, resulting in oxidative stress in farmed animals [ 13 ].
statement: 随着大规模集约化养殖的发展，过高的养殖密度和恶劣的水质环境导致环境中应激因子增加，从而引起养殖动物产生氧化应激。
text_zh: 随着大规模集约化养殖的发展，过高的养殖密度和恶劣的水质环境导致环境中应激因子增加，从而引起养殖动物产生氧化应激。
text_en: With the development of large-scale intensive farming, excessively high stocking densities and poor water quality environments lead to an increase in stress factors in the environment, thereby causing oxidative stress in farmed animals.

quote: When the fish body is strongly stimulated, it can cause the antioxidant system in the body to lose balance, leading to metabolic disorders.
statement: 当鱼体受到强烈刺激时，会导致体内抗氧化系统失衡，引发代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 当鱼体受到强烈刺激时，会导致体内抗氧化系统失衡，引发代谢紊乱。
text_en: When fish are subjected to strong stimulation, it leads to an imbalance in the antioxidant system within the body, triggering metabolic disorders.

quote: Long-term oxidative stress can affect the growth rate of fish and lead to a decline in their quality [ 15 ].
statement: 长期氧化应激会影响鱼类的生长速度并导致其品质下降。
text_zh: 长期氧化应激会影响鱼类的生长速度并导致其品质下降。
text_en: Long-term oxidative stress affects the growth rate of fish and leads to a decline in their quality.

quote: Previous studies have suggested that excessive dietary fat levels can lead to a decline in the growth performance of young carp, affecting their body composition, blood lipid content, and glycolysis, resulting in oxidative stress [ 16 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，过高的日粮脂肪水平会导致鲤鱼幼鱼生长性能下降，影响其体成分、血脂含量和糖酵解，从而导致氧化应激。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，过高的日粮脂肪水平会导致鲤鱼幼鱼生长性能下降，影响其体成分、血脂含量和糖酵解，从而导致氧化应激。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that excessively high dietary fat levels lead to decreased growth performance in juvenile carp, affecting their body composition, blood lipid content, and glycolysis, thereby causing oxidative stress.

quote: All animal procedures were strictly carried out in accordance with the relevant guidelines (license No. HNFI20230610) and were approved by the Animal Welfare and Ethics Committee of Hunan Fisheries Science Institute (program approval on 22 December 2022).
statement: 所有动物程序均严格按照相关指南进行，并获得了湖南渔业科学研究所动物福利与伦理委员会的批准。
text_zh: 所有动物程序均严格按照相关指南进行，并获得了湖南渔业科学研究所动物福利与伦理委员会的批准。
text_en: All animal procedures were strictly conducted in accordance with relevant guidelines and were approved by the Animal Welfare and Ethics Committee of the Hunan Institute of Fisheries Science.

quote: The water temperature was kept at 26 ± 2 °C, dissolved oxygen was ≥5 mg/L, pH was 7.2–7.5, and the adaptation period was one week.
statement: 水温保持在26±2°C，溶解氧≥5 mg/L，pH值为7.2-7.5，适应期为两周。
text_zh: 水温保持在26±2°C，溶解氧≥5 mg/L，pH值为7.2-7.5，适应期为两周。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 26±2°C, dissolved oxygen ≥5 mg/L, pH value 7.2-7.5, and the adaptation period was two weeks.

quote: During the adaptation period, all fish were fed with live bait fish ( Mrigal carp ) twice per day to clear satiety, with approximately 80 live bait fish used per kilogram, and a feeding rate of 20% wet weight.
statement: 在适应期内，所有鱼每天投喂两次活饵鱼（鲮鱼）至饱食，每千克约使用80条活饵鱼，投喂率为湿重的20%。
text_zh: 在适应期内，所有鱼每天投喂两次活饵鱼（鲮鱼）至饱食，每千克约使用80条活饵鱼，投喂率为湿重的20%。
text_en: During the acclimation period, all fish were fed live bait fish (dace) twice daily to satiation, using about 80 live bait fish per kilogram, with a feeding rate of 20% of wet weight.

quote: The expression of GPx , keap1 , kappa , gr , gsta , and gstt1 was significantly downregulated after 14 days, and the expression of gr and SOD was significantly upregulated after 7 days.
statement: 在人工饲料驯化后，鳜鱼肝脏中GPx、keap1、kappa、gr、gsta和gstt1基因的表达在14天后显著下调，而gr和SOD基因的表达在7天后显著上调。
text_zh: 在人工饲料驯化后，鳜鱼肝脏中GPx、keap1、kappa、gr、gsta和gstt1基因的表达在14天后显著下调，而gr和SOD基因的表达在7天后显著上调。
text_en: After acclimation to artificial feed, the expression of GPx, keap1, kappa, gr, gsta and gstt1 genes in the liver of mandarin fish was significantly downregulated after 14 days, while the expression of gr and SOD genes was significantly upregulated after 7 days.

quote: The activity of SOD and CAT was apparently unchanged ( Figure 5 A,B).
statement: 人工饲料驯化后，鳜鱼肝脏中SOD和CAT的活性无明显变化。
text_zh: 人工饲料驯化后，鳜鱼肝脏中SOD和CAT的活性无明显变化。
text_en: After domestication to artificial feed, there was no significant change in the activity of SOD and CAT in the liver of mandarin fish.

quote: The GPx activity was significantly higher in the 7-day experimental group than it was in the control group ( Figure 5 C), and the MDA content was significantly higher in the 7-day experimental group than it was in the control group ( Figure 5 D).
statement: 与对照组相比，7天实验组（人工饲料驯化）的GPx活性和MDA含量均显著升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，7天实验组（人工饲料驯化）的GPx活性和MDA含量均显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, GPx activity and MDA content in the 7-day experimental group (artificial feed acclimation) were both significantly increased.

quote: The Effect of Short-Term Artificial Feed Domestication on the Expression of Oxidative-Stress-Related Genes and Antioxidant Capacity in the Liver and Gill Tissues of Mandarin Fish ( Siniperca chuatsi )
statement: 研究旨在探讨短期人工饲料驯化对鳜鱼肝脏和鳃组织中氧化应激相关基因表达及抗氧化能力的影响。
text_zh: 研究旨在探讨短期人工饲料驯化对鳜鱼肝脏和鳃组织中氧化应激相关基因表达及抗氧化能力的影响。
text_en: The study aimed to investigate the effects of short-term artificial feed acclimation on the expression of oxidative stress-related genes and antioxidant capacity in the liver and gill tissues of mandarin fish.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化能力

quote: To investigate whether Mandarin fish developed oxidative stress after being domesticated with artificial feed, we conducted a series of experiments.
statement: 进行了一系列实验以调查鳜鱼在人工饲料驯化后是否产生氧化应激。
text_zh: 进行了一系列实验以调查鳜鱼在人工饲料驯化后是否产生氧化应激。
text_en: A series of experiments were conducted to investigate whether mandarin fish experienced oxidative stress after domestication to artificial feed.

quote: We divided the Mandarin fish into two groups for treatment. The control group was fed with live bait continuously for 14 days, while the experimental group was fed with half artificial feed and half live bait from 0 to 7 days (T-7 d), followed by solely artificial feed from 7 to 14 days (T-14 d).
statement: 将鳜鱼分为两组处理：对照组连续14天投喂活饵；实验组在0至7天投喂一半人工饲料和一半活饵（T-7 d），随后在7至14天仅投喂人工饲料（T-14 d）。
text_zh: 将鳜鱼分为两组处理：对照组连续14天投喂活饵；实验组在0至7天投喂一半人工饲料和一半活饵（T-7 d），随后在7至14天仅投喂人工饲料（T-14 d）。
text_en: Mandarin fish were divided into two treatment groups: the control group was fed live bait continuously for 14 days; the experimental group was fed half artificial feed and half live bait from day 0 to day 7 (T-7 d), followed by only artificial feed from day 7 to day 14 (T-14 d).
intervention: Co-feeding live bait and artificial feed with gradual withdrawal
intervention_record: 活饵与人工饲料共投喂并逐步撤除活饵

quote: The experimental results showed that there was no difference in the body weight, length, and standard growth rate of the Mandarin fish between the two groups of treatments;
statement: 实验结果表明，两组处理间鳜鱼的体重、体长和标准生长率无差异。
text_zh: 实验结果表明，两组处理间鳜鱼的体重、体长和标准生长率无差异。
text_en: The experimental results showed no difference in body weight, body length, and specific growth rate of mandarin fish between the two treatment groups.

quote: after being domesticated with artificial feed... The aim of this study was to investigate the effects of short-term artificial feed domestication on the expression of oxidative stress genes and the changes in oxidative-stress-related enzyme activity in the liver and gills of Mandarin fish.
statement: 研究目的是调查短期人工饲料驯化对鳜鱼肝脏和鳃中氧化应激基因表达及氧化应激相关酶活性变化的影响。
text_zh: 研究目的是调查短期人工饲料驯化对鳜鱼肝脏和鳃中氧化应激基因表达及氧化应激相关酶活性变化的影响。
text_en: The study aimed to investigate the effects of short-term artificial feed acclimation on changes in oxidative stress gene expression and oxidative stress-related enzyme activities in the liver and gills of mandarin fish.

quote: We assume that domesticated mandarin fish are more susceptible and have a lower survival rate, possibly due to oxidative stress and decreased antioxidant capacity.
statement: 我们假设驯养的鳜鱼更易感且存活率较低，这可能是由于氧化应激和抗氧化能力下降所致。
text_zh: 我们假设驯养的鳜鱼更易感且存活率较低，这可能是由于氧化应激和抗氧化能力下降所致。
text_en: We hypothesize that captive-reared mandarin fish are more susceptible and have lower survival rates, which may be due to oxidative stress and decreased antioxidant capacity.
outcome: 易感性、存活率、氧化应激

quote: In the future, we can focus on how to reduce the oxidative stress that Mandarin fish experience during domestication with feed, for example, by adding antioxidants to feed.
statement: Future work could focus on reducing oxidative stress in Mandarin fish during domestication by adding antioxidants to feed.
text_en: Future work could focus on reducing oxidative stress in Mandarin fish during domestication by adding antioxidants to feed.

quote: The results demonstrated that the SOD activity in the gill tissue was significantly lower in the 7-day experimental group than it was in the control group ( Figure 3 A)
statement: 人工饲料驯化7天后，鳜鱼鳃组织中的SOD活性显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 人工饲料驯化7天后，鳜鱼鳃组织中的SOD活性显著低于对照组。
text_en: After 7 days of acclimation to artificial feed, the SOD activity in the gill tissue of mandarin fish was significantly lower than that of the control group.

quote: while CAT activity was apparently unchanged ( Figure 3 B) after 14 days.
statement: 驯化14天后，鳜鱼鳃组织中的CAT活性无明显变化。
text_zh: 驯化14天后，鳜鱼鳃组织中的CAT活性无明显变化。
text_en: After 14 days of acclimation, there was no significant change in CAT activity in the gill tissue of mandarin fish.

quote: After domestication, the GPx activity was significantly lower than in the control group ( Figure 3 C)
statement: 驯化后，鳜鱼鳃组织中的GPx活性显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 驯化后，鳜鱼鳃组织中的GPx活性显著低于对照组。
text_en: After acclimation, GPx activity in the gill tissue of mandarin fish was significantly lower than that of the control group.

quote: while the content of MDA was apparently unchanged ( Figure 3 D).
statement: 驯化后，鳜鱼鳃组织中的MDA含量无明显变化。
text_zh: 驯化后，鳜鱼鳃组织中的MDA含量无明显变化。
text_en: After domestication, there was no significant change in MDA content in the gill tissue of mandarin fish.

quote: Research has shown that nutritional imbalance and anti-nutritional factors in compound feed can lead to an increase in liver fat content and a decrease in food intake in Mandarin fish [ 24 ].
statement: 研究表明，配合饲料中的营养不平衡和抗营养因子会导致鳜鱼肝脏脂肪含量增加和摄食量减少。
text_zh: 研究表明，配合饲料中的营养不平衡和抗营养因子会导致鳜鱼肝脏脂肪含量增加和摄食量减少。
text_en: Studies show that nutritional imbalance and anti-nutritional factors in compound feed lead to increased liver fat content and reduced feed intake in mandarin fish.
outcome: 肝脏脂肪含量与摄食量

quote: Our research indicates that after short-term domestication with feed, there was no difference in the body weight, length, and standard growth rate of Mandarin fish compared to live fish fed with artificial feed.
statement: 我们的研究指出，经过短期饲料驯化后，鳜鱼的体重、体长和标准生长率与投喂人工饲料的活饵组相比没有差异。
text_zh: 我们的研究指出，经过短期饲料驯化后，鳜鱼的体重、体长和标准生长率与投喂人工饲料的活饵组相比没有差异。
text_en: Our study indicates that after short-term domestication with feed, the body weight, body length, and specific growth rate of mandarin fish showed no difference compared to the live bait group fed artificial feed.
outcome: 生长性能（体重、体长、生长率）
limitations: 驯化时间较短 (short domestication time)

quote: Studies have shown that the timing of domestication and the nutritional composition of the artificial feed are key factors affecting the survival rate of M. salmoides [ 25 ].
statement: 研究表明，驯化时机和人工饲料的营养成分是影响大口黑鲈存活率的关键因素。
text_zh: 研究表明，驯化时机和人工饲料的营养成分是影响大口黑鲈存活率的关键因素。
text_en: Research indicates that the timing of domestication and the nutritional composition of artificial feed are key factors affecting the survival rate of largemouth bass.

quote: In the future, we need to strengthen our understanding of the nutritional requirements and digestive system development of Mandarin fish, which is the key to improving the survival rate.
statement: 未来需要加强对鳜鱼营养需求和消化系统发育的理解，这是提高其存活率的关键。
text_zh: 未来需要加强对鳜鱼营养需求和消化系统发育的理解，这是提高其存活率的关键。
text_en: Future research needs to strengthen the understanding of nutritional requirements and digestive system development in mandarin fish, which is key to improving their survival rate.
intervention: Understanding nutritional needs and digestive development
intervention_record: 了解营养需求与消化发育

quote: whereas nutritional imbalances could disrupt the homeostasis of the pro-oxidant–antioxidant system, leading to oxidative stress [ 26 , 27 ].
statement: 营养失衡可能破坏促氧化-抗氧化系统的稳态，导致氧化应激。
text_zh: 营养失衡可能破坏促氧化-抗氧化系统的稳态，导致氧化应激。
text_en: Nutritional imbalances may disrupt the homeostasis of the pro-oxidant-antioxidant system, leading to oxidative stress.

quote: Butyrate has been reported to have multiple beneficial effects on gut health because it can be quickly absorbed by the epithelial cells of the terminal ileum and large intestine, especially in colon, thus it provides energy for the epithelial cells to stimulate their proliferation, differentiation, maturation, and reduces cell apoptosis ( Cummings and Macfarlane, 1997 ).
statement: 丁酸盐对肠道健康有多种有益作用，因为它能被回肠末端和大肠（尤其是结肠）的上皮细胞快速吸收，从而为上皮细胞提供能量以刺激其增殖、分化、成熟并减少细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 丁酸盐对肠道健康有多种有益作用，因为它能被回肠末端和大肠（尤其是结肠）的上皮细胞快速吸收，从而为上皮细胞提供能量以刺激其增殖、分化、成熟并减少细胞凋亡。
text_en: Butyrate has multiple beneficial effects on gut health because it is rapidly absorbed by the epithelial cells of the terminal ileum and large intestine (especially the colon), thereby providing energy to the epithelial cells to stimulate their proliferation, differentiation, and maturation, and reduce cell apoptosis.
outcome: 肠道健康与细胞完整性

quote: Previous studies showed that sodium butyrate supplementation in diet is beneficial for villous-crypt architecture, thus improving gut barrier function and the host digestive efficiency ( Galfi and Bokori, 1990 ; Wang et al., 2012 ).
statement: 先前的研究表明，日粮中添加丁酸钠有利于绒毛-隐窝结构，从而改善肠道屏障功能和宿主的消化效率。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，日粮中添加丁酸钠有利于绒毛-隐窝结构，从而改善肠道屏障功能和宿主的消化效率。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that dietary supplementation with sodium butyrate is beneficial for the villus-crypt structure, thereby improving intestinal barrier function and host digestive efficiency.
outcome: 肠道屏障功能与消化效率

quote: However, after 14 days of domestication, the expression of oxidative-stress-related genes was generally downregulated.
statement: 在驯化14天后，与氧化应激相关的基因表达普遍下调。
text_zh: 在驯化14天后，与氧化应激相关的基因表达普遍下调。
text_en: After 14 days of acclimation, the expression of genes related to oxidative stress was generally downregulated.
outcome: 氧化应激相关基因表达

quote: This indicates that Mandarin fish experience oxidative stress during short-term domestication and resist oxidative damage by regulating gene expression.
statement: 这表明鳜鱼在短期驯化期间经历氧化应激，并通过调节基因表达来抵抗氧化损伤。
text_zh: 这表明鳜鱼在短期驯化期间经历氧化应激，并通过调节基因表达来抵抗氧化损伤。
text_en: This indicates that mandarin fish experience oxidative stress during short-term acclimation and resist oxidative damage by regulating gene expression.

quote: In this study, there was a significant difference in MDA content in the liver after 7 days of domestication, but there was no difference in MDA content after 14 days, indicating that the liver experienced oxidative stress during the short-term domestication of Mandarin fish.
statement: 本研究中，驯化7天后肝脏MDA含量有显著差异，但14天后无差异，表明鳜鱼在短期驯化期间肝脏经历了氧化应激。
text_zh: 本研究中，驯化7天后肝脏MDA含量有显著差异，但14天后无差异，表明鳜鱼在短期驯化期间肝脏经历了氧化应激。
text_en: In this study, liver MDA content showed a significant difference after 7 days of acclimation, but no difference after 14 days, indicating that mandarin fish experienced oxidative stress in the liver during short-term acclimation.

quote: In this study, the GPx content in the liver significantly increased after 7 days of domestication in the case of Mandarin fish, but there was no difference after 14 days, indicating that the antioxidant capacity of GPx enzymes may play a major role within 7 days of domestication;
statement: 本研究中，鳜鱼驯化7天后肝脏GPx含量显著增加，但14天后无差异，表明GPx酶的抗氧化能力可能在驯化7天内起主要作用；
text_zh: 本研究中，鳜鱼驯化7天后肝脏GPx含量显著增加，但14天后无差异，表明GPx酶的抗氧化能力可能在驯化7天内起主要作用；
text_en: In this study, liver GPx content in mandarin fish increased significantly after 7 days of acclimation, but there was no difference after 14 days, indicating that the antioxidant capacity of the GPx enzyme may play a major role within the first 7 days of acclimation.

quote: the GPx content of gills significantly decreased after 14 days of domestication.
statement: 驯化14天后，鳃的GPx含量显著降低。
text_zh: 驯化14天后，鳃的GPx含量显著降低。
text_en: After 14 days of acclimation, gill GPx content significantly decreased.

quote: Artificial feed can cause varying degrees of oxidative stress in aquatic animals.
statement: 人工饲料可引起水生动物不同程度的氧化应激。
text_zh: 人工饲料可引起水生动物不同程度的氧化应激。
text_en: Artificial feed can cause varying degrees of oxidative stress in aquatic animals.

quote: Adding an appropriate amount of Lycium barbarum Polysaccharide to feed can not only improve the growth performance and feed utilization of snakehead fish but also enhance its antioxidant capacity. In addition, it can also enhance its immune system [ 50 ].
statement: 在饲料中添加适量的枸杞多糖不仅能改善乌鳢的生长性能和饲料利用率，还能增强其抗氧化能力和免疫系统。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加适量的枸杞多糖不仅能改善乌鳢的生长性能和饲料利用率，还能增强其抗氧化能力和免疫系统。
text_en: Adding an appropriate amount of Lycium barbarum polysaccharides to feed can not only improve the growth performance and feed utilization of Channa argus, but also enhance its antioxidant capacity and immune system.
outcome: 生长性能、饲料利用率、抗氧化能力、免疫系统

quote: Studies have shown that adding phospholipids to feed can significantly reduce the content of MDA in the liver of juvenile snakehead fish, improve total antioxidant capacity and SOD activity, and alleviate oxidative damage to the liver of juvenile snakehead fish.
statement: 研究表明，在饲料中添加磷脂可显著降低幼乌鳢肝脏中的MDA含量，提高总抗氧化能力和SOD活性，并减轻幼乌鳢肝脏的氧化损伤。
text_zh: 研究表明，在饲料中添加磷脂可显著降低幼乌鳢肝脏中的MDA含量，提高总抗氧化能力和SOD活性，并减轻幼乌鳢肝脏的氧化损伤。
text_en: Studies have shown that adding phospholipids to feed can significantly reduce MDA content in the liver of juvenile snakehead, improve total antioxidant capacity and SOD activity, and alleviate oxidative damage in the liver of juvenile snakehead.
outcome: 肝脏氧化损伤、抗氧化能力

quote: These provide ideas for improving artificial feed to domesticate Mandarin fish and enhance their antioxidant capacity in the future.
statement: 这些研究为改进人工饲料以驯养鳜鱼并在未来增强其抗氧化能力提供了思路。
text_zh: 这些研究为改进人工饲料以驯养鳜鱼并在未来增强其抗氧化能力提供了思路。
text_en: These studies provide ideas for improving artificial feed to acclimate mandarin fish and enhance their antioxidant capacity in the future.

quote: The expression of oxidative stress genes in the liver ( GPx , keap1 , kappa , gr , gsta , gstt1 , SOD , and gr ) and gills ( keap1 , kappa , gsta , gstt1 , gstk1 , SOD , and CAT ) of Mandarin fish domesticated with artificial feed changed, and their antioxidant capacity decreased.
statement: 用人工饲料驯养的鳜鱼肝脏和鳃中氧化应激基因的表达发生变化，且其抗氧化能力下降。
text_zh: 用人工饲料驯养的鳜鱼肝脏和鳃中氧化应激基因的表达发生变化，且其抗氧化能力下降。
text_en: The expression of oxidative stress genes in the liver and gills of mandarin fish acclimated to artificial feed changed, and their antioxidant capacity decreased.
outcome: 氧化应激基因表达、抗氧化能力

quote: It has been reported that high-fat diets could increase LPS content in feces and decrease the expression of gut tight junction proteins to enhance gut permeability by changing gut microbial composition, which results in more LPS leakage into the circulation, thus inducing inflammation ( Kim et al., 2012 ; Lim et al., 2016 ).
statement: 据报道，高脂饮食可通过改变肠道微生物组成来增加粪便中的LPS含量并降低肠道紧密连接蛋白的表达，从而增强肠道通透性，导致更多LPS泄漏到循环中，进而诱发炎症。
text_zh: 据报道，高脂饮食可通过改变肠道微生物组成来增加粪便中的LPS含量并降低肠道紧密连接蛋白的表达，从而增强肠道通透性，导致更多LPS泄漏到循环中，进而诱发炎症。
text_en: It is reported that a high-fat diet can increase fecal LPS content and reduce the expression of intestinal tight junction proteins by altering the gut microbiota composition, thereby enhancing intestinal permeability, leading to more LPS leakage into circulation, and subsequently inducing inflammation.

quote: In the studies of excessive addition of carbohydrate in diet, the formation of inflammation was also observed, and mechanism of inflammation induced by a high-sugar diet was considered to be the same with the mechanism of inflammation induced by a high-fat diets ( Do et al., 2018 ).
statement: 在日粮中过量添加碳水化合物的研究中，也观察到了炎症的形成，且认为高糖饮食诱导的炎症机制与高脂饮食诱导的炎症机制相同。
text_zh: 在日粮中过量添加碳水化合物的研究中，也观察到了炎症的形成，且认为高糖饮食诱导的炎症机制与高脂饮食诱导的炎症机制相同。
text_en: In studies with excessive carbohydrate supplementation in the diet, inflammation formation was also observed, and it is considered that the mechanism of inflammation induced by a high-sugar diet is the same as that induced by a high-fat diet.

quote: In this study, we found that after 7 days of domestication, the expression of SOD and gr mRNA was significantly upregulated in the liver.
statement: 本研究发现，经过7天的驯化后，肝脏中SOD和gr mRNA的表达显著上调。
text_zh: 本研究发现，经过7天的驯化后，肝脏中SOD和gr mRNA的表达显著上调。
text_en: This study found that after 7 days of domestication, the mRNA expression of SOD and gr in the liver was significantly upregulated.

quote: While the expression of keap1 , kappa , gsta , CAT , and SOD mRNA was significantly downregulated in gills after 14 days of domestication.
statement: 而在经过14天的驯化后，鳃中keap1、kappa、gsta、CAT和SOD mRNA的表达显著下调。
text_zh: 而在经过14天的驯化后，鳃中keap1、kappa、gsta、CAT和SOD mRNA的表达显著下调。
text_en: After 14 days of domestication, the mRNA expression of keap1, kappa, gsta, CAT and SOD in the gills was significantly downregulated.
outcome: 鳃部抗氧化相关基因表达

quote: After 7 days of domestication, the expression of oxidative stress related genes in Mandarin fish was generally upregulated.
statement: 经过7天的驯化后，鳜鱼中与氧化应激相关的基因表达普遍上调。
text_zh: 经过7天的驯化后，鳜鱼中与氧化应激相关的基因表达普遍上调。
text_en: After 7 days of domestication, the expression of genes related to oxidative stress in mandarin fish was generally upregulated.
outcome: 整体氧化应激基因表达水平

quote: We assume that this is due to the Mandarin fish increasing the expression of oxidative stress genes to enhance antioxidant capacity.
statement: 作者推测这是由于鳜鱼增加氧化应激基因的表达以增强抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 作者推测这是由于鳜鱼增加氧化应激基因的表达以增强抗氧化能力。
text_en: The authors speculate that this is due to mandarin fish increasing the expression of oxidative stress genes to enhance antioxidant capacity.

quote: We believe this may be due to oxidative damage and decreased gene expression in the Mandarin fish.
statement: 作者认为这可能是由于鳜鱼遭受了氧化损伤并导致基因表达下降。
text_zh: 作者认为这可能是由于鳜鱼遭受了氧化损伤并导致基因表达下降。
text_en: The authors believe this may be due to oxidative damage suffered by mandarin fish and a resulting decrease in gene expression.

quote: We found that gut microbial diversity, beneficial bacteria quantity, and lactic acid content were higher in C10 group than in the other groups.
statement: 与对照组相比，喂食10%淀粉饲料（C10组）的鳜鱼肠道微生物多样性、有益菌数量和乳酸含量更高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，喂食10%淀粉饲料（C10组）的鳜鱼肠道微生物多样性、有益菌数量和乳酸含量更高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, mandarin fish fed a 10% starch diet (C10 group) had higher intestinal microbial diversity, beneficial bacteria counts, and lactic acid content.

quote: The lower level of gut microbial diversity was observed in C20 group, and mycoplasma was the overwhelmingly dominant species, but the butyric acid-producing bacteria and butyric acid level were significantly reduced.
statement: 在喂食20%淀粉饲料（C20组）的鳜鱼中观察到较低的肠道微生物多样性，支原体成为绝对优势物种，且产丁酸细菌和丁酸水平显著降低。
text_zh: 在喂食20%淀粉饲料（C20组）的鳜鱼中观察到较低的肠道微生物多样性，支原体成为绝对优势物种，且产丁酸细菌和丁酸水平显著降低。
text_en: In mandarin fish fed a 20% starch diet (C20 group), lower intestinal microbial diversity was observed, Mycoplasma became the absolute dominant species, and butyrate-producing bacteria and butyrate levels were significantly reduced.

quote: The gut permeability in C20 group was also increased due to the decreased mRNA expression levels of tight junction proteins caused by the butyric acid deficiency and gut lipid droplets accumulation.
statement: 由于丁酸缺乏和肠道脂滴积累导致紧密连接蛋白mRNA表达水平下降，C20组的肠道通透性增加。
text_zh: 由于丁酸缺乏和肠道脂滴积累导致紧密连接蛋白mRNA表达水平下降，C20组的肠道通透性增加。
text_en: Intestinal permeability increased in the C20 group due to decreased tight junction protein mRNA expression levels caused by butyrate deficiency and intestinal lipid droplet accumulation.

quote: Then a large amount of LPS penetrated into the plasma, resulting in inflammation.
statement: 随后大量脂多糖（LPS）渗入血浆，导致炎症。
text_zh: 随后大量脂多糖（LPS）渗入血浆，导致炎症。
text_en: Subsequently, a large amount of lipopolysaccharide (LPS) infiltrated the plasma, causing inflammation.

quote: These results suggested that high carbohydrate diet-induced damage in gut could be attributed to the endotoxemia, permeability, and gut microbiota, especially the role of mycoplasma and butyric acid-producing bacteria.
statement: 结果表明，高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤可归因于内毒素血症、通透性和肠道菌群，特别是支原体和产丁酸细菌的作用。
text_zh: 结果表明，高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤可归因于内毒素血症、通透性和肠道菌群，特别是支原体和产丁酸细菌的作用。
text_en: The results indicate that intestinal damage caused by a high-carbohydrate diet can be attributed to endotoxemia, permeability, and gut microbiota, particularly the roles of Mycoplasma and butyrate-producing bacteria.

quote: These data showed that the high-carbohydrate diet reversed the beneficial changes in gut microbial metabolism resulted from the medium-carbohydrate diet, and further demonstrated that microbiota played a key role in the gut damage caused by the high-carbohydrate diet.
statement: 高碳水化合物饮食逆转了中碳水化合物饮食带来的肠道微生物代谢有益变化，并表明微生物群在由高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤中起关键作用。
text_zh: 高碳水化合物饮食逆转了中碳水化合物饮食带来的肠道微生物代谢有益变化，并表明微生物群在由高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤中起关键作用。
text_en: A high-carbohydrate diet reversed the beneficial changes in gut microbial metabolism brought about by a medium-carbohydrate diet, and indicated that the microbiota plays a key role in the intestinal damage caused by a high-carbohydrate diet.
outcome: 肠道健康与微生物代谢

quote: Our findings provide a reference for the targeted regulation of gut microbiota to mitigate the damage caused by the increase in starch content in fish feed (cost saving).
statement: 研究结果提供了通过靶向调节肠道微生物群以减轻鱼饲料中淀粉含量增加（旨在节约成本）所造成损害的参考。
text_zh: 研究结果提供了通过靶向调节肠道微生物群以减轻鱼饲料中淀粉含量增加（旨在节约成本）所造成损害的参考。
text_en: The research results provide a reference for mitigating the damage caused by increased starch content in fish feed (aimed at saving costs) through targeted modulation of the gut microbiota.
outcome: 缓解饲料成分引起的肠道损伤

quote: However, the use of excessive carbohydrate in diets could damage fish’s physiological function
statement: 然而，日粮中过量碳水化合物的使用可能会损害鱼类的生理功能。
text_zh: 然而，日粮中过量碳水化合物的使用可能会损害鱼类的生理功能。
text_en: However, the use of excessive carbohydrates in the diet may impair the physiological functions of fish.

quote: Compared with 0% starch group, 10% starch group showed a significant increase in specific growth rate, and 20% starch group exhibited the suppressed growth performance, liver damage, and metabolism disorder (unpublished).
statement: 与0%淀粉组相比，10%淀粉组的特定生长率显著增加，而20%淀粉组表现出受抑制的生长性能、肝脏损伤和代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 与0%淀粉组相比，10%淀粉组的特定生长率显著增加，而20%淀粉组表现出受抑制的生长性能、肝脏损伤和代谢紊乱。
text_en: Compared with the 0% starch group, the specific growth rate of the 10% starch group increased significantly, while the 20% starch group showed inhibited growth performance, liver damage, and metabolic disorders.
intervention: Diets with different pregelatinized starch contents
intervention_record: 不同预糊化淀粉含量日粮
outcome: 生长性能、肝脏健康及代谢状态
counterevidence: 20%淀粉导致生长抑制、肝损伤和代谢紊乱

quote: and these fermentation products help improve the immune system
statement: 这些发酵产物有助于改善免疫系统。
text_zh: 这些发酵产物有助于改善免疫系统。
text_en: These fermentation products help improve the immune system.

quote: High levels of fat in diet change the gut microbial community, particularly by increasing the ratio of Firmicutes to Bacteroidetes to affect health of the host
statement: 高水平的膳食脂肪会改变肠道微生物群落，特别是通过增加厚壁菌门与拟杆菌门的比例来影响宿主健康。
text_zh: 高水平的膳食脂肪会改变肠道微生物群落，特别是通过增加厚壁菌门与拟杆菌门的比例来影响宿主健康。
text_en: High levels of dietary fat alter the gut microbiota, particularly by affecting host health through an increase in the Firmicutes to Bacteroidetes ratio.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落结构与宿主健康

quote: Herein, three diets containing different levels of gelatinized starch were fed to Chinese perch for 56 days.
statement: 研究将含有不同水平糊化淀粉的三种饲料喂食鳜鱼56天。
text_zh: 研究将含有不同水平糊化淀粉的三种饲料喂食鳜鱼56天。
text_en: The study fed mandarin fish three diets containing different levels of gelatinized starch for 56 days.
intervention: Diets with different pregelatinized starch contents
intervention_record: 不同预糊化淀粉含量日粮

quote: Gut microbiota, SCFA, and gut health of different groups were tested.
statement: 测试了各组别的肠道微生物群、短链脂肪酸和肠道健康状况。
text_zh: 测试了各组别的肠道微生物群、短链脂肪酸和肠道健康状况。
text_en: The gut microbiota, short-chain fatty acids, and gut health status of each group were tested.

quote: Exploring the key role of gut microbiota in gut damage caused by high-carbohydrate diet will help to screen targeted probiotics/prebiotics to improve fish tolerance to high-carbohydrate diets (cost savings).
statement: 探索肠道微生物群在高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤中的关键作用，有助于筛选靶向益生菌/益生元以提高鱼类对高碳水化合物饮食的耐受性（从而节省成本）。
text_zh: 探索肠道微生物群在高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤中的关键作用，有助于筛选靶向益生菌/益生元以提高鱼类对高碳水化合物饮食的耐受性（从而节省成本）。
text_en: Exploring the key role of the gut microbiota in intestinal damage caused by high-carbohydrate diets helps screen for targeted probiotics/prebiotics to improve fish tolerance to high-carbohydrate diets (thereby saving costs).
intervention_record: 筛选靶向益生菌/益生元
outcome: 对高碳水饮食的耐受性

quote: The primers for housekeeping gene ( RPL13A ), fatty acid synthesis-related genes [fatty acid synthesis ( FAS ) and Acetyl-CoA carboxylase 1 ( ACC1 )], tight junction protein genes (zonula occludens-1 ( ZO-1 ) and occludin ), and pro-inflammatory cytokines genes [ p65-NF- κ B, PAI , Tumor Necrosis Factor α ( TNF- α), IL-I β] used in the present study were listed in Table 2 .
statement: 本研究使用实时荧光定量PCR检测了肠道中脂肪酸合成相关基因、紧密连接蛋白基因和促炎细胞因子基因的表达水平。
text_zh: 本研究使用实时荧光定量PCR检测了肠道中脂肪酸合成相关基因、紧密连接蛋白基因和促炎细胞因子基因的表达水平。
text_en: This study used real-time fluorescent quantitative PCR to detect the expression levels of fatty acid synthesis-related genes, tight junction protein genes, and pro-inflammatory cytokine genes in the intestine.
outcome: 肠道屏障功能与炎症反应

quote: Research by Cong has shown that compared to the fresh Pacific jade tendon fish ( Ammodytes personatus ), using compound feed can lead to a decrease in the antioxidant capacity of the pearl gentian grouper ( Epinephelus lanceolatus ) [ 38 ].
statement: Cong的研究表明，与新鲜玉筋鱼相比，使用配合饲料会导致珍珠龙胆石斑鱼的抗氧化能力下降。
text_zh: Cong的研究表明，与新鲜玉筋鱼相比，使用配合饲料会导致珍珠龙胆石斑鱼的抗氧化能力下降。
text_en: Cong's research showed that, compared to fresh sand lance, the use of formulated feed led to a decrease in the antioxidant capacity of pearl dragon grouper.

quote: Different types of feed can, to some extent, alter the antioxidant capacity of aquatic animals.
statement: 不同类型的饲料在一定程度上可以改变水生动物的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 不同类型的饲料在一定程度上可以改变水生动物的抗氧化能力。
text_en: Different types of feed can change the antioxidant capacity of aquatic animals to some extent.

quote: Research has found that adding 47% carbohydrates to the feed of Megalobrama ambrycyphala significantly increases GOT activity in its serum, while liver SOD and T-AOC activities show a decreasing trend [ 39 ].
statement: 研究发现，在鳊鱼饲料中添加47%的碳水化合物会显著增加其血清GOT活性，而肝脏SOD和T-AOC活性呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 研究发现，在鳊鱼饲料中添加47%的碳水化合物会显著增加其血清GOT活性，而肝脏SOD和T-AOC活性呈下降趋势。
text_en: The study found that adding 47% carbohydrates to the feed of bream significantly increased their serum GOT activity, while liver SOD and T-AOC activities showed a decreasing trend.

quote: In a study of M. salmoides , it was found that with an increase in dietary starch levels, the MDA content in the liver increased [ 40 ].
statement: 在对大口黑鲈的一项研究中发现，随着日粮淀粉水平的增加，肝脏MDA含量增加。
text_zh: 在对大口黑鲈的一项研究中发现，随着日粮淀粉水平的增加，肝脏MDA含量增加。
text_en: In a study on largemouth bass, liver MDA content increased as dietary starch levels increased.

quote: High sugar feed can cause oxidative stress in Yellow River carp, exacerbating the degree of lipid peroxidation in the body, thus damaging health [ 41 ].
statement: 高糖饲料会引起黄河鲤的氧化应激，加剧体内脂质过氧化程度，从而损害健康。
text_zh: 高糖饲料会引起黄河鲤的氧化应激，加剧体内脂质过氧化程度，从而损害健康。
text_en: High-sugar diets cause oxidative stress in the Yellow River carp, exacerbating lipid peroxidation in the body and thereby impairing health.

quote: The liver SOD, CAT, GPx, GR, and T-AOC activity of black carp, Yellow River carp [ 42 ], and spotted seabass [ 43 ] fed a high-fat diet were significantly reduced, while the MDA content was significantly increased [ 44 ].
statement: 喂食高脂饲料的青鱼、黄河鲤和斑点海鲈的肝脏SOD、CAT、GPx、GR和T-AOC活性显著降低，而MDA含量显著增加。
text_zh: 喂食高脂饲料的青鱼、黄河鲤和斑点海鲈的肝脏SOD、CAT、GPx、GR和T-AOC活性显著降低，而MDA含量显著增加。
text_en: The liver SOD, CAT, GPx, GR and T-AOC activities were significantly decreased, while the MDA content was significantly increased, in black carp, yellow river carp and spotted sea bass fed a high-fat diet.

population.species: 青鱼; 黄河鲤; 斑点海鲈

outcome: 抗氧化酶活性/氧化损伤

quote: Research has shown that adding baicalein to feed can reduce the serum MDA content of grass carp ( Ctenopharyngodon idella ) while increasing CAT and SOD activities, thereby enhancing antioxidant capacity [ 45 ].
statement: 研究表明，在饲料中添加黄芩素可以降低草鱼的血清MDA含量，同时提高CAT和SOD活性，从而增强抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 研究表明，在饲料中添加黄芩素可以降低草鱼的血清MDA含量，同时提高CAT和SOD活性，从而增强抗氧化能力。
text_en: Studies show that adding baicalein to feed can reduce serum MDA content in grass carp, while increasing CAT and SOD activity, thereby enhancing antioxidant capacity.

quote: Adding quercetin to feed can increase the antioxidant enzyme activity in the liver of Yellow River carp [ 46 ], zebrafish [ 47 ], common carp ( Cyprinus carpio ) [ 48 ], and snakehead ( Channa argus ) [ 49 ] and reduce liver MDA content.
statement: 在饲料中添加槲皮素可以增加黄河鲤、斑马鱼、鲤鱼和黑鱼肝脏中的抗氧化酶活性并降低肝脏MDA含量。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加槲皮素可以增加黄河鲤、斑马鱼、鲤鱼和黑鱼肝脏中的抗氧化酶活性并降低肝脏MDA含量。
text_en: Adding quercetin to feed can increase antioxidant enzyme activity and decrease liver MDA content in Yellow River carp, zebrafish, common carp, and blackfish.

population.species: 黄河鲤; 斑马鱼; 鲤鱼; 黑鱼

outcome: 抗氧化酶活性/氧化损伤

quote: Compared with those in C0 group, the number of OTUs and Shannon indices were significantly increased in C10 group ( P 0.05), while they were significantly decreased in C20 group ( P 0.05)
statement: 与对照组相比，添加10%糊化淀粉的饲料组中肠道微生物OTU数量和Shannon指数显著增加，而添加20%糊化淀粉的饲料组中则显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，添加10%糊化淀粉的饲料组中肠道微生物OTU数量和Shannon指数显著增加，而添加20%糊化淀粉的饲料组中则显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the control group, the number of gut microbial OTUs and the Shannon index significantly increased in the feed group with 10% gelatinized starch, while they significantly decreased in the feed group with 20% gelatinized starch.

quote: Those results suggested that the microbial diversity was first increased ( P 0.05) and then decreased ( P 0.05), as gelatinized starch content was increased in diets.
statement: 随着日粮中糊化淀粉含量的增加，肠道微生物多样性先升高后降低。
text_zh: 随着日粮中糊化淀粉含量的增加，肠道微生物多样性先升高后降低。
text_en: As the content of gelatinized starch in the diet increased, intestinal microbial diversity first increased and then decreased.

quote: However, compared with C0 group, C20 group had significantly lower abundance in almost all the genera ( P 0.05) except for Mycoplasma spp.
statement: 与对照组相比，20%糊化淀粉挑战组的肠道菌群中几乎所有属的丰度均显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，20%糊化淀粉挑战组的肠道菌群中几乎所有属的丰度均显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the abundance of almost all genera in the gut microbiota of the 20% gelatinized starch challenge group was significantly reduced.

quote: The abundance of Gram-negative bacteria was significantly decreased in C10 and C20 groups, compared to C0 group
statement: 与对照组相比，10%和20%糊化淀粉挑战组中革兰氏阴性菌的丰度显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，10%和20%糊化淀粉挑战组中革兰氏阴性菌的丰度显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the control group, the abundance of Gram-negative bacteria was significantly reduced in the 10% and 20% gelatinized starch challenge groups.

quote: Eight out of fifteen potential butyrate-producing bacteria could not be isolated from gut microbiota in C20 group, indicating that many kinds of butyrate-producing bacteria could not survive in gut of Chinese perch fed with diets with 20% gelatinized starch.
statement: 在20%糊化淀粉组中，无法从肠道微生物群中分离出15种潜在丁酸产生菌中的8种，表明许多种类的丁酸产生菌无法在饲喂含20%糊化淀粉日粮的中国鳜鱼肠道中存活。
text_zh: 在20%糊化淀粉组中，无法从肠道微生物群中分离出15种潜在丁酸产生菌中的8种，表明许多种类的丁酸产生菌无法在饲喂含20%糊化淀粉日粮的中国鳜鱼肠道中存活。
text_en: In the 20% gelatinized starch group, 8 of the 15 potential butyrate-producing bacteria could not be isolated from the gut microbiota, indicating that many species of butyrate-producing bacteria cannot survive in the intestines of Chinese perch fed a diet containing 20% gelatinized starch.

quote: Fish were fed twice daily (08:00 and 18:00) at 5% body weight. Each feeding lasted for 1 h.
statement: 鱼每天喂食两次（08:00和18:00），投喂量为体重的5%，每次喂食持续1小时。
text_zh: 鱼每天喂食两次（08:00和18:00），投喂量为体重的5%，每次喂食持续1小时。
text_en: Fish were fed twice daily (at 08:00 and 18:00) at a rate of 5% of body weight, with each feeding lasting 1 hour.

quote: After 56-day feeding, all fish were anesthetized with 150 mg/L tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, Sigma, United States) at 6 h after the morning meal.
statement: 经过56天的喂养后，所有鱼在早餐后6小时用150毫克/升的三甲磺酸酯（MS-222）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 经过56天的喂养后，所有鱼在早餐后6小时用150毫克/升的三甲磺酸酯（MS-222）进行麻醉。
text_en: After 56 days of feeding, all fish were anesthetized with 150 mg/L of MS-222 (tricaine methanesulfonate) 6 hours after breakfast.

quote: A 4-kDa fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC)-dextran was purchased from Sigma-Aldrich (St. Louis, MO, United States) and used to determine the gut permeability after 8-week feeding, as described in previous studies ( Cani et al., 2008 ; Do et al., 2018 ).
statement: 使用4-kDa异硫氰酸荧光素（FITC）葡聚糖测定喂养8周后的肠道通透性。
text_zh: 使用4-kDa异硫氰酸荧光素（FITC）葡聚糖测定喂养8周后的肠道通透性。
text_en: Intestinal permeability was measured using 4-kDa fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC) dextran after 8 weeks of feeding.

quote: The endotoxin level of hindgut content in C20 group was significantly lower than that in C0 group ( P 0.05).
statement: C20组（20%糊化淀粉挑战组）后肠内容物中的内毒素水平显著低于C0组（非挑战对照组）。
text_zh: C20组（20%糊化淀粉挑战组）后肠内容物中的内毒素水平显著低于C0组（非挑战对照组）。
text_en: The endotoxin levels in the hindgut contents of the C20 group (20% gelatinized starch challenge group) were significantly lower than those in the C0 group (non-challenge control group).

quote: However, it was significantly higher than that in C0 group in plasma ( P 0.05).
statement: 然而，C20组血浆中的内毒素水平显著高于C0组。
text_zh: 然而，C20组血浆中的内毒素水平显著高于C0组。
text_en: However, plasma endotoxin levels in the C20 group were significantly higher than those in the C0 group.

quote: In addition, the total content of SCFAs was significantly decreased in C20 group ( P 0.05) ( Figure 5A )
statement: 此外，C20组的短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）总含量显著降低。
text_zh: 此外，C20组的短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）总含量显著降低。
text_en: In addition, the total content of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in the C20 group was significantly reduced.
outcome: 肠道短链脂肪酸总含量

quote: and the LAc content was significantly increased in C10 group compared with that in C0 group ( P 0.05) ( Figure 5B ).
statement: 与C0组相比，C10组（10%糊化淀粉挑战组）的乳酸（LAc）含量显著增加。
text_zh: 与C0组相比，C10组（10%糊化淀粉挑战组）的乳酸（LAc）含量显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the C0 group, the lactic acid (LAc) content in the C10 group (10% gelatinized starch challenge group) increased significantly.

quote: found that only the content of butyric acid was significantly decreased in C20 group relative to C0 group ( P 0.05) ( Figure 5F ).
statement: 发现仅C20组的丁酸含量相对于C0组显著降低。
text_zh: 发现仅C20组的丁酸含量相对于C0组显著降低。
text_en: It was found that butyrate content in the C20 group only was significantly lower than that in the C0 group.

quote: Interestingly, the abundance of the Firmicutes was the highest ( P 0.05) in C10 group ( Figure 2A ).
statement: 厚壁菌门的丰度在C10组（含10%糊化淀粉）中最高。
text_zh: 厚壁菌门的丰度在C10组（含10%糊化淀粉）中最高。
text_en: The abundance of Firmicutes was highest in the C10 group (containing 10% gelatinized starch).

quote: Ten genera belonged to Firmicutes , such as Streptococcus spp., Lactococcus spp., Lactobacillus spp., and Geobacillus spp. ( P 0.05); three genera belonged to Actinobacteria , such as Bifidobacterium spp. and Corynebacterium spp. ( P 0.05); and one genus ( Mycoplasma spp.) belonged to Tenericutes ( P 0.05) ( Figure 3A ).
statement: C10组中显著增加的属包括属于厚壁菌门的链球菌、乳球菌、乳酸杆菌等，属于放线菌门的双歧杆菌、棒状杆菌等，以及属于柔膜菌门的支原体。
text_zh: C10组中显著增加的属包括属于厚壁菌门的链球菌、乳球菌、乳酸杆菌等，属于放线菌门的双歧杆菌、棒状杆菌等，以及属于柔膜菌门的支原体。
text_en: In the C10 group, significantly increased genera included Streptococcus, Lactococcus, and Lactobacillus belonging to Firmicutes; Bifidobacterium and Corynebacterium belonging to Actinobacteria; and Mycoplasma belonging to Tenericutes.
outcome: 潜在益生菌或条件致病菌群丰度

quote: indicating that 20% gelatinized starch addition increased the expression of lipid metabolism-related genes, resulting in excessive deposition of lipid droplets in gut.
statement: 这表明添加20%糊化淀粉增加了脂质代谢相关基因的表达，导致肠道内脂滴过度沉积。
text_zh: 这表明添加20%糊化淀粉增加了脂质代谢相关基因的表达，导致肠道内脂滴过度沉积。
text_en: This indicates that adding 20% gelatinized starch increased the expression of genes related to lipid metabolism, leading to excessive deposition of lipid droplets in the intestine.
outcome: 肠道健康/脂质代谢紊乱

quote: In addition, compared with that of C0 group, the relative mRNA expression of the genes involved in inflammatory factor infiltration ( p65-NF- κ B , PAI , IL-1 β, and TNF- α) were significantly decreased in gut tissues of C20 group ( P 0.05) ( Figures 8B,C )
statement: 此外，与对照组相比，20%糊化淀粉组肠道组织中参与炎症因子浸润的基因（p65-NF-κB、PAI、IL-1β和TNF-α）的相对mRNA表达显著降低。
text_zh: 此外，与对照组相比，20%糊化淀粉组肠道组织中参与炎症因子浸润的基因（p65-NF-κB、PAI、IL-1β和TNF-α）的相对mRNA表达显著降低。
text_en: In addition, compared with the control group, the relative mRNA expression of genes involved in inflammatory factor infiltration (p65-NF-κB, PAI, IL-1β and TNF-α) in intestinal tissue was significantly reduced in the 20% gelatinized starch group.
counterevidence: 尽管组织学显示炎症细胞浸润，但炎症因子的mRNA表达却显著降低。

quote: suggesting that the system might inhibit the expression of pro-inflammatory factors through feedback regulation.
statement: 这表明该系统可能通过反馈调节抑制促炎因子的表达。
text_zh: 这表明该系统可能通过反馈调节抑制促炎因子的表达。
text_en: This indicates that the system may suppress the expression of pro-inflammatory factors through feedback regulation.

quote: C0 group and C10 group demonstrate the normal physiological features of the gut villus, whereas C20 group shows severe pathological changes.
statement: C0组和C10组显示肠绒毛的正常生理特征，而C20组显示出严重的病理变化。
text_zh: C0组和C10组显示肠绒毛的正常生理特征，而C20组显示出严重的病理变化。
text_en: Groups C0 and C10 showed normal physiological characteristics of intestinal villi, while group C20 showed severe pathological changes.
counterevidence: 尽管炎症基因表达降低，但高剂量淀粉导致严重病理变化

quote: Compared with C0 group, C10 group exhibited a significant increase in gut villus length and wall thickness ( Table 5 , P 0.05).
statement: 与对照组相比，10%糊化淀粉挑战组的肠绒毛长度和肠壁厚度显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，10%糊化淀粉挑战组的肠绒毛长度和肠壁厚度显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, intestinal villus length and intestinal wall thickness significantly increased in the 10% gelatinized starch challenge group.

quote: However, C20 group showed a significant decrease in gut villus length and wall thickness ( P 0.05).
statement: 然而，20%糊化淀粉挑战组的肠绒毛长度和肠壁厚度显著降低。
text_zh: 然而，20%糊化淀粉挑战组的肠绒毛长度和肠壁厚度显著降低。
text_en: However, intestinal villus length and intestinal wall thickness were significantly reduced in the 20% gelatinized starch challenge group.

quote: Compared with that in C0 group, pH of gut chyme was significantly decreased in C10 group ( P 0.05).
statement: 与对照组相比，10%糊化淀粉挑战组肠道食糜的pH值显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，10%糊化淀粉挑战组肠道食糜的pH值显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the pH of intestinal chyme in the 10% gelatinized starch challenge group was significantly reduced.

quote: However, pH of gut chyme in C20 group was significantly increased ( P 0.05), and lysozyme activity was significantly decreased ( P 0.05).
statement: 然而，20%糊化淀粉挑战组肠道食糜的pH值显著升高，且溶菌酶活性显著降低。
text_zh: 然而，20%糊化淀粉挑战组肠道食糜的pH值显著升高，且溶菌酶活性显著降低。
text_en: However, the pH of intestinal chyme in the 20% gelatinized starch challenge group significantly increased, and lysozyme activity significantly decreased.

quote: This indicated that the addition of gelatinized starch to diet was important for the changes in the microbiota of gut, and that the addition of an appropriate amount of gelatinized starch was beneficial to gut microbiota, enabling the microbial community to utilize the nutrients better in gut by enhancing membrane transport pathways.
statement: 这表明向日粮中添加糊化淀粉对肠道微生物群的变化很重要，且添加适量的糊化淀粉有利于肠道微生物群，通过增强膜运输途径使微生物群落更好地利用肠道内的营养物质。
text_zh: 这表明向日粮中添加糊化淀粉对肠道微生物群的变化很重要，且添加适量的糊化淀粉有利于肠道微生物群，通过增强膜运输途径使微生物群落更好地利用肠道内的营养物质。
text_en: This indicates that adding gelatinized starch to sunflower meal is important for changes in the gut microbiota, and adding an appropriate amount of gelatinized starch benefits the gut microbiota by enhancing membrane transport pathways to allow microbial communities to better utilize nutrients within the gut.

quote: Our experiments reveal the key role of gut microbiota and related metabolites in the process of high carbohydrate diet-induced inflammation, which will help to screen targeted probiotics/prebiotics and add them to the feed to mitigate the gut damage caused by high-carbohydrate diets.
statement: 实验揭示了肠道微生物群及相关代谢物在高碳水化合物饮食诱导的炎症过程中的关键作用，这有助于筛选靶向益生菌/益生元并添加到饲料中，以减轻高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤。
text_zh: 实验揭示了肠道微生物群及相关代谢物在高碳水化合物饮食诱导的炎症过程中的关键作用，这有助于筛选靶向益生菌/益生元并添加到饲料中，以减轻高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤。
text_en: The experiment revealed the key role of gut microbiota and related metabolites in inflammation induced by high-carbohydrate diets, which helps screen for targeted probiotics/prebiotics to add to feed to alleviate intestinal damage caused by high-carbohydrate diets.
intervention_record: 添加靶向益生菌/益生元

quote: In the present study, gut microbial community diversity of Chinese perch was significantly decreased after feeding with high-starch diet, suggesting that supplementation of gelatinized starch to diet can also reshape gut microbiota, just like high-fructose, and high-glucose and high-fat diets ( Li et al., 2016 ).
statement: 本研究中，喂食高淀粉饲料后，鳜鱼的肠道微生物群落多样性显著降低，表明在日粮中添加糊化淀粉也可以重塑肠道微生物群，类似于高果糖、高葡萄糖和高脂饮食的作用。
text_zh: 本研究中，喂食高淀粉饲料后，鳜鱼的肠道微生物群落多样性显著降低，表明在日粮中添加糊化淀粉也可以重塑肠道微生物群，类似于高果糖、高葡萄糖和高脂饮食的作用。
text_en: In this study, feeding a high-starch diet significantly reduced the diversity of the intestinal microbial community in mandarin fish, indicating that adding gelatinized starch to the diet can also reshape the gut microbiota, similar to the effects of high-fructose, high-glucose, and high-fat diets.

quote: However, the change trend of gut microbiota composition in Chinese perch was significantly different from that in mammals after feeding with high carbohydrate diet.
statement: 然而，喂食高碳水化合物日粮后，鳜鱼肠道微生物组成的变化趋势与哺乳动物显著不同。
text_zh: 然而，喂食高碳水化合物日粮后，鳜鱼肠道微生物组成的变化趋势与哺乳动物显著不同。
text_en: However, the trend of changes in gut microbiota composition in mandarin fish after being fed a high-carbohydrate diet is significantly different from that in mammals.

quote: C20 group also showed significantly higher plasma FITC-dextran levels than C0 group at 4 h after oral administration ( Figure 7D , P 0.05).
statement: 与对照组相比，20%糊化淀粉组在口服给药后4小时的血浆FITC-葡聚糖水平显著升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，20%糊化淀粉组在口服给药后4小时的血浆FITC-葡聚糖水平显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, plasma FITC-dextran levels were significantly increased in the 20% gelatinized starch group at 4 hours after oral administration.

quote: C20 group also exhibited a greater area under the curve for plasma FITC-dextran than the C0 group ( Figure 7E , P 0.05).
statement: 20%糊化淀粉组的血浆FITC-葡聚糖曲线下面积大于对照组。
text_zh: 20%糊化淀粉组的血浆FITC-葡聚糖曲线下面积大于对照组。
text_en: The area under the curve of plasma FITC-dextran in the 20% gelatinized starch group was greater than that in the control group.

quote: Compared with those of C0 group, the relative expressions of ZO-1 and occludin of C20 group were significantly decreased ( P 0.05).
statement: 与对照组相比，20%糊化淀粉组的ZO-1和occludin相对表达量显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，20%糊化淀粉组的ZO-1和occludin相对表达量显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the relative expression levels of ZO-1 and occludin in the 20% gelatinized starch group were significantly decreased.

quote: The results showed that 20% gelatinized starch in diet significantly increased gut permeability compared to 0% of the gelatinized starch in diet ( P 0.05).
statement: 结果表明，与0%糊化淀粉日粮相比，20%糊化淀粉日粮显著增加了肠道通透性。
text_zh: 结果表明，与0%糊化淀粉日粮相比，20%糊化淀粉日粮显著增加了肠道通透性。
text_en: The results showed that, compared to the 0% gelatinized starch diet, the 20% gelatinized starch diet significantly increased intestinal permeability.

quote: The H E staining on gut sections confirmed the infiltration of inflammation cell in C20 group ( Figure 8A ), indicating that long-term feeding of 20% gelatinized starch diet could cause inflammation in Chinese perch gut.
statement: HE染色证实了20%糊化淀粉组炎症细胞的浸润，表明长期饲喂20%糊化淀粉日粮可能导致鳜鱼肠道炎症。
text_zh: HE染色证实了20%糊化淀粉组炎症细胞的浸润，表明长期饲喂20%糊化淀粉日粮可能导致鳜鱼肠道炎症。
text_en: HE staining confirmed the infiltration of inflammatory cells in the 20% gelatinized starch group, indicating that long-term feeding with a 20% gelatinized starch diet may lead to intestinal inflammation in mandarin fish.

quote: In this experiment, the guts of the moderate gelatinized starch diet group were the healthiest relative to those of other groups, and gut microbial diversity and the abundance of gut microbiota in moderate gelatinized starch diet group were the highest
statement: 本实验中，中等糊化淀粉日粮组的肠道相对于其他组最健康，且该组的肠道微生物多样性和丰度最高。
text_zh: 本实验中，中等糊化淀粉日粮组的肠道相对于其他组最健康，且该组的肠道微生物多样性和丰度最高。
text_en: In this experiment, the diet group with medium gelatinized starch had the healthiest intestines compared to other groups, and this group had the highest intestinal microbial diversity and abundance.
outcome: 肠道健康与微生物群落结构

quote: Therefore, the long-term feeding with 0% gelatinized starch diet and 20% gelatinized starch diet caused certain irritation to gut of Chinese perch, which resulted in the up-regulation of energy metabolism level and the metabolism level of coenzyme factors and vitamins relative to the 10% gelatinized starch diet group.
statement: 长期饲喂0%和20%糊化淀粉日粮对鳜鱼肠道造成了一定刺激，导致其能量代谢水平以及辅酶因子和维生素代谢水平相对于10%糊化淀粉日粮组上调。
text_zh: 长期饲喂0%和20%糊化淀粉日粮对鳜鱼肠道造成了一定刺激，导致其能量代谢水平以及辅酶因子和维生素代谢水平相对于10%糊化淀粉日粮组上调。
text_en: Long-term feeding of diets with 0% and 20% gelatinized starch caused a certain degree of irritation to the intestines of mandarin fish, leading to an upregulation of their energy metabolism levels as well as coenzyme factor and vitamin metabolism levels compared to the group fed a diet with 10% gelatinized starch.

quote: It could be concluded that the addition of 10% starch in diets is beneficial to the health of gut via changing microbial functionality.
statement: 可以得出结论，日粮中添加10%淀粉通过改变微生物功能有利于肠道健康。
text_zh: 可以得出结论，日粮中添加10%淀粉通过改变微生物功能有利于肠道健康。
text_en: It can be concluded that the addition of 10% starch to the diet benefits gut health by altering microbial functions.

quote: However, the high-carbohydrate diet (20%) reversed the beneficial changes in gut microbial metabolism caused by the medium carbohydrate diet (10%).
statement: 然而，高碳水化合物日粮（20%）逆转了由中碳水化合物日粮（10%）引起的肠道微生物代谢的有益变化。
text_zh: 然而，高碳水化合物日粮（20%）逆转了由中碳水化合物日粮（10%）引起的肠道微生物代谢的有益变化。
text_en: However, the high-carbohydrate diet (20%) reversed the beneficial changes in gut microbial metabolism caused by the medium-carbohydrate diet (10%).

quote: Our results further demonstrate that microbiota play a key role in the gut damage caused by the high-carbohydrate diet.
statement: 我们的结果进一步证明，微生物群落在高碳水化合物日粮引起的肠道损伤中起关键作用。
text_zh: 我们的结果进一步证明，微生物群落在高碳水化合物日粮引起的肠道损伤中起关键作用。
text_en: Our results further demonstrate that the microbiota plays a key role in intestinal damage induced by high-carbohydrate diets.

quote: lute dominant bacteria in gut micro-organisms after long-term feeding with high dietary gelatinized starch in Chinese perch, thus the growth space of other bacteria was compressed to a certain extent, result in no significant increase in the proportion of Firmicutes -to- Bacteroidetes ratios or proportions of Proteobacteria .
statement: 长期饲喂高糊化淀粉饲料导致中国鲈肠道微生物中绝对优势菌出现，压缩了其他细菌的生长空间，致使厚壁菌门/拟杆菌门比例或变形菌门比例无显著增加。
text_zh: 长期饲喂高糊化淀粉饲料导致中国鲈肠道微生物中绝对优势菌出现，压缩了其他细菌的生长空间，致使厚壁菌门/拟杆菌门比例或变形菌门比例无显著增加。
text_en: Long-term feeding of high-gelatinized starch feed led to the emergence of an absolutely dominant bacterium in the gut microbiota of Chinese perch, compressing the growth space of other bacteria, resulting in no significant increase in the Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratio or Proteobacteria proportion.

quote: High carbohydrate diet-induced damage in gut might be associated with the changes in gut microbiota and permeability in mammals.
statement: 高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤可能与哺乳动物肠道微生物群和通透性的变化有关。
text_zh: 高碳水化合物饮食引起的肠道损伤可能与哺乳动物肠道微生物群和通透性的变化有关。
text_en: Intestinal damage caused by a high-carbohydrate diet may be related to changes in the gut microbiota and permeability of mammals.

quote: Our study indicated that the relative abundances of Gram-negative bacteria and butyric acid-producing bacteria were also significantly decreased due to the proliferation of Tenericutes , which had a great impact on gut health in the high gelatinized starch diet group.
statement: 本研究表明，由于柔膜菌门的增殖，革兰氏阴性菌和丁酸产生菌的相对丰度也显著降低，这对高糊化淀粉饮食组的肠道健康产生了巨大影响。
text_zh: 本研究表明，由于柔膜菌门的增殖，革兰氏阴性菌和丁酸产生菌的相对丰度也显著降低，这对高糊化淀粉饮食组的肠道健康产生了巨大影响。
text_en: This study showed that due to the proliferation of Tenericutes, the relative abundance of Gram-negative bacteria and butyrate-producing bacteria also significantly decreased, which had a huge impact on gut health in the high-gelatinized-starch diet group.

quote: Gram-negative bacteria are the main source of LPS ( Cani et al., 2008 ) which was reported to induce inflammation by infiltrating the circulation in the case of the increased gut permeability ( Kim et al., 2012 ; Lim et al., 2016 ).
statement: 革兰氏阴性菌是脂多糖（LPS）的主要来源，据报道在肠道通透性增加的情况下，LPS通过渗入循环系统诱导炎症。
text_zh: 革兰氏阴性菌是脂多糖（LPS）的主要来源，据报道在肠道通透性增加的情况下，LPS通过渗入循环系统诱导炎症。
text_en: Gram-negative bacteria are the main source of lipopolysaccharide (LPS), and it is reported that LPS induces inflammation by entering the circulatory system when intestinal permeability increases.

quote: However, our study showed the opposite result that the change in gut microbiota composition significantly decreased LPS content in chyme in high gelatinized starch diet group, compared with control group, which was beneficial to the gut health to a certain extent.
statement: 然而，本研究显示相反的结果：与对照组相比，高糊化淀粉饮食组肠道菌群组成的变化显著降低了食糜中的LPS含量，这在一定程度上有利于肠道健康。
text_zh: 然而，本研究显示相反的结果：与对照组相比，高糊化淀粉饮食组肠道菌群组成的变化显著降低了食糜中的LPS含量，这在一定程度上有利于肠道健康。
text_en: However, this study showed the opposite result: compared with the control group, the change in gut microbiota composition in the high-gelatinized-starch diet group significantly reduced LPS content in chyme, which is beneficial to gut health to some extent.

quote: In this experiment, the gut permeability was significantly increased, and butyrate content was sharply decreased due to the reduction in the relative abundance of butyric acid producing bacteria.
statement: 在本实验中，由于产丁酸菌相对丰度的降低，肠道通透性显著增加，且丁酸盐含量急剧下降。
text_zh: 在本实验中，由于产丁酸菌相对丰度的降低，肠道通透性显著增加，且丁酸盐含量急剧下降。
text_en: In this experiment, due to the decrease in the relative abundance of butyrate-producing bacteria, intestinal permeability increased significantly, and butyrate content decreased sharply.
outcome: 肠道通透性与丁酸盐水平

quote: In addition, high gelatinized starch diets caused gut lipid metabolism disorders in Chinese perch, further resulting in the deposition of a large amount of lipid droplets in gut, which might have a direct effect on gut structure and gut function.
statement: 此外，高糊化淀粉饮食导致鳜鱼肠道脂质代谢紊乱，进而导致大量脂滴沉积在肠道中，这可能对肠道结构和功能产生直接影响。
text_zh: 此外，高糊化淀粉饮食导致鳜鱼肠道脂质代谢紊乱，进而导致大量脂滴沉积在肠道中，这可能对肠道结构和功能产生直接影响。
text_en: In addition, the high-gelatinized starch diet caused intestinal lipid metabolism disorders in mandarin fish, leading to a large accumulation of lipid droplets in the intestine, which may have a direct impact on intestinal structure and function.
outcome: 肠道脂质代谢与结构功能

quote: Based on these results, it could be concluded that butyric acid deficiency and gut lipid droplet excessive accumulation cause an increase in gut permeability, thus causing more LPS to penetrate into the plasma, finally causing inflammation infiltration in the gut tract
statement: 丁酸缺乏和肠道脂滴过度积累导致肠道通透性增加，进而使更多LPS渗入血浆，最终引起肠道炎症浸润。
text_zh: 丁酸缺乏和肠道脂滴过度积累导致肠道通透性增加，进而使更多LPS渗入血浆，最终引起肠道炎症浸润。
text_en: Butyrate deficiency and excessive intestinal lipid droplet accumulation lead to increased intestinal permeability, which in turn allows more LPS to leak into the plasma, ultimately causing intestinal inflammatory infiltration.

quote: This study may provide data basis for the effective application of butyric acid-producing bacteria or butyric acid in high-starch diet.
statement: 本研究可为在高淀粉日粮中有效应用产丁酸细菌或丁酸提供数据基础。
text_zh: 本研究可为在高淀粉日粮中有效应用产丁酸细菌或丁酸提供数据基础。
text_en: This study can provide a data basis for the effective application of butyric acid-producing bacteria or butyric acid in high-starch diets.
intervention: Adding butyrate-producing bacteria or butyric acid
outcome: 缓解高淀粉饮食对肠道健康的负面影响

quote: (A) 20% gelatinized starch diets affect gut health by altering microbial composition and gut lipid metabolism in non-mammals with butyric acid playing a key role in that process.
statement: 20%糊化淀粉日粮通过改变非哺乳动物的微生物组成和肠道脂质代谢影响肠道健康，其中丁酸在该过程中起关键作用。
text_zh: 20%糊化淀粉日粮通过改变非哺乳动物的微生物组成和肠道脂质代谢影响肠道健康，其中丁酸在该过程中起关键作用。
text_en: A 20% gelatinized starch diet affects gut health by altering the microbial composition and intestinal lipid metabolism in non-mammals, with butyrate playing a key role in this process.

quote: (B) 10% gelatinized starch is beneficial to the structure of gut by changing gut microbiota diversity, beneficial bacteria quantity, and lactic acid content.
statement: 10%糊化淀粉通过改变肠道菌群多样性、有益菌数量和乳酸含量，有利于肠道结构。
text_zh: 10%糊化淀粉通过改变肠道菌群多样性、有益菌数量和乳酸含量，有利于肠道结构。
text_en: 10% gelatinized starch benefits intestinal structure by altering gut microbiota diversity, the number of beneficial bacteria, and lactic acid content.

quote: High gelatinized starch diets cause gut microbial changes and lipid metabolism disorders, which further leads to inflammation.
statement: 高糊化淀粉日粮引起肠道微生物变化和脂质代谢紊乱，进而导致炎症。
text_zh: 高糊化淀粉日粮引起肠道微生物变化和脂质代谢紊乱，进而导致炎症。
text_en: Highly gelatinized starch diets cause changes in gut microbiota and lipid metabolism disorders, leading to inflammation.

quote: However, the moderate amount of gelatinized starch in diets is beneficial to the health of gut ( Figure 9A ).
statement: 然而，日粮中适量的糊化淀粉对肠道健康是有益的。
text_zh: 然而，日粮中适量的糊化淀粉对肠道健康是有益的。
text_en: However, an appropriate amount of gelatinized starch in the diet is beneficial to gut health.

quote: It has been demonstrated that gut microbiota assists in feed adaptation and improves the feed conversion rate in fish.
statement: 已有研究表明肠道微生物群有助于鱼类饲料适应并提高饲料转化率。
text_zh: 已有研究表明肠道微生物群有助于鱼类饲料适应并提高饲料转化率。
text_en: Existing studies have shown that the gut microbiota helps fish adapt to feed and improves feed conversion ratio.

quote: The α-diversity index of the gut microbiota in groups that were fed a compound diet was significantly higher ( p 0.05) than that in the live bait group.
statement: 投喂配合饲料组的鳜鱼肠道微生物α多样性指数显著高于投喂活饵组。
text_zh: 投喂配合饲料组的鳜鱼肠道微生物α多样性指数显著高于投喂活饵组。
text_en: The intestinal microbial alpha diversity index of mandarin fish in the formulated diet feeding group was significantly higher than that in the live bait feeding group.

quote: The results indicated that certain taxa mentioned above exist in large individuals and may be closely related to the digestion and absorption of compound diets.
statement: 结果表明上述某些类群存在于大个体中，可能与配合饲料的消化吸收密切相关。
text_zh: 结果表明上述某些类群存在于大个体中，可能与配合饲料的消化吸收密切相关。
text_en: The results showed that certain groups mentioned above were present in larger individuals, which may be closely related to the digestion and absorption of compound feed.

quote: The health of gut is largely determined by the acidity and alkalinity of gut environment ( Kohl et al., 2013 ).
statement: 肠道健康在很大程度上由肠道环境的酸碱度决定。
text_zh: 肠道健康在很大程度上由肠道环境的酸碱度决定。
text_en: Gut health is largely determined by the pH of the gut environment.

quote: Previous study has reported that in an alkaline environment, the abundance of beneficial bacteria, such as lactic acid bacteria, was decreased, that of harmful bacteria was increased, resulting in gut immune function decline ( Jeurissen et al., 2002 ).
statement: 先前研究报道，在碱性环境中，乳酸菌等有益菌丰度降低，有害菌丰度增加，导致肠道免疫功能下降。
text_zh: 先前研究报道，在碱性环境中，乳酸菌等有益菌丰度降低，有害菌丰度增加，导致肠道免疫功能下降。
text_en: Previous studies reported that in an alkaline environment, the abundance of beneficial bacteria such as lactic acid bacteria decreased, while the abundance of harmful bacteria increased, leading to a decline in intestinal immune function.

quote: In this experiment, moderate gelatinized starch diets caused an increase in gut microbiota diversity relative to control group, and the relative abundance of many beneficial bacteria was significantly improved relative to control group at genera level, including Lactococcus , Lactobacillus , Geobacillus , Clostridium , Bifidobacterium , and so on.
statement: 本实验中，与对照组相比，适量糊化淀粉日粮增加了肠道微生物多样性，并在属水平上显著提高了包括乳球菌、乳杆菌、地芽孢杆菌、梭菌和双歧杆菌在内的许多有益菌的相对丰度。
text_zh: 本实验中，与对照组相比，适量糊化淀粉日粮增加了肠道微生物多样性，并在属水平上显著提高了包括乳球菌、乳杆菌、地芽孢杆菌、梭菌和双歧杆菌在内的许多有益菌的相对丰度。
